newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia names new envoy to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia names new envoy to Philippines.

text.p: A senior Australian diplomat whose proposed appointment as ambassador to Indonesia was abandoned earlier this year after protests from Jakarta was on Tuesday named ambassador to the Philippines.
Miles Kupa, 49, will replace Richard Smith, who has been ambassador in Manila since April, 1994, Foreign Minister Alexander Downer said in a statement.
Kupa was a senior adviser to former foreign minister Gareth Evans from 1991 to 1993.
His latest posting follows controversy over his planned appointment as ambassador to Indonesia earlier this year.
Indonesian opposition to his planned appointment prompted Kupa to ask Downer to withdraw his nomination in June to head off a row between the two neighbours.
Kupa had written a confidential briefing in 1988, after a posting to Jakarta, critical of the business interests of President Suharto's family. Details of his comments were leaked in 1992.
Kupa, regarded as one of the foreign department's leading Indonesia experts, was ambassador to Iraq in the mid-1980s and has also been posted to Cairo and Paris.
